title: Jeff W NDE 4452
content: I was on the passenger side of a car when it was hit on a freeway in Georgia. When I saw the car front end about two feet away, everything positive in my life ran through my brain like a high-speed camera. The next thing I could remember was that I was an entity in the sky. As the entity, I had no thoughts about the actual person who was in the accident. The feelings I had of the entity was that it was powerful and somewhat all knowing. Even though I turned into this entity, I felt no connection between who I am as a human and whom the entity was. I woke up, upside down on the driver's side of the car.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death'
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Right before the car hit and right before I woke up.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I had no perceptible body, I just existed.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Felt all the good feeling in my life right before the car hit. As the 'entity' I felt very content.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Life is all about the good things.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes As the 'entity' I felt very knowledgeable.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Life is about good things and we are not who we think we are.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Just about anyone I got to know.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Something very special.
